title: Allowance for a Listing that Has Stopped Earning
content:
What has been paid into the host's Keyturn Host Payout Account in trip earnings decides the idle period allowance a Keyturn Vehicle Listing carries against the reported stretch. Two windows are read: the rolling twelve months counted back from the handling date, and the rolling three months.

- A vehicle whose host has been paid 500 USD or more of trip earnings in the rolling twelve months counted back from the handling date and nothing in the rolling three months is allowed 30 miles of idle period use against the reported stretch.
- A vehicle whose host has been paid 500 USD or more in the rolling twelve months and something in the rolling three months is allowed 15 miles.
- Any other vehicle is allowed none on this ground, an allowance of 0 miles.

### How the two windows combine

| Trip earnings in the rolling twelve months | Trip earnings in the rolling three months | Allowed against the reported stretch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 500 USD or more | none at all | 30 miles |
| 500 USD or more | any amount above nothing | 15 miles |
| below 500 USD | any | 0 miles |

The twelve month window is the gate: a host paid 480 USD of trip earnings over the year is allowed nothing on this ground, whatever the quarter shows. Where the gate is met, the quarter decides: a host paid exactly 500 USD over the year with nothing at all in the last quarter is allowed 30 miles, and the same host paid 20 USD in the last quarter is allowed 15 miles.
